name: Resume Matcher
description: Tool that tailors a resume and cover letter to a job description using local or hosted LLMs.
whatItDoes: Compares a resume against a job posting, suggests improvements and produces tailored versions and cover letters for job seekers.
howItWorks: A FastAPI backend calls models through LiteLLM and a Next.js front end provides the editor, with the provider chosen in settings. It can run from source or as a single Docker container.

requirements.name: Docker
requirements.description: Container route; source route needs Python 3.13+ and Node.js 22+

requirements.name: LLM provider
requirements.description: A hosted provider key or a local Ollama server
